id.description: The unique and required id of this instance.

triggered.description: The time that the notification was triggered.

severity.description: The severity of the notification, which determines the icon to display.

appId.description: The ID of the app the notification is associated with, if any.

source.description: The type this notification represents or is associated with.

sourceId.description: Optional source attribution to attach to the notification for granular filtering

metadata.description: Additional relevant information or fields that allow us to identify a source object, construct a link, etc.
